           EPIGEA REPENS

         Trailing Arbutus


Chronic cystitis, with   dysuria  ;
        tenesmus after micturition;   muco-pus and uric-acid deposit  ,
        gravel, renal calculi. Fine sand in urine of a   brown color  .
        Burning in neck of bladder whilst urinating and tenesmus afterward. Pyelitis, incontinence
        of urine. Croaking noise and rumbling in bowels.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Uva, Chimaph,
        Lyc; Pareira  . Epigea contains Arbutin, also Formic acid.



Dose.--  Tincture in 5-drop doses every three hours.
